name: OpenPage Self-Hosted Website Builder
free_limit: MIT-licensed visual website builder with drag-and-drop editing, JSON-first site configuration, 19 block types and standalone HTML export; no vendor-enforced usage quota or software expiry for self-managed use.
watch_out: Run and maintain the editor yourself. AI generation requires a separately configured Gemini API key and serverless endpoint, which may incur API or hosting charges; exported sites also require your own hosting. The public demo is not a free managed hosting allowance.
